question: Among healthcare providers whose practice location is in Mountain View, CA, and who have a specified specialization in the field healthcare provider taxonomy, identify the top 10 most common specializations based on the count of distinct NPIs. Then determine which of those top 10 has a count of distinct NPIs closest to the average count across those 10 specializations.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT primary_specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT npi) as distinct_npi_count
  FROM (
    SELECT npi,
         CASE WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_1 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_1_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_2 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_2_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_3 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_3_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_4 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_4_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_5 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_5_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_6 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_6_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_7 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_7_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_8 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_8_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_9 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_9_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_10 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_10_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_11 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_11_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_12 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_12_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_13 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_13_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_14 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_14_specialization
              WHEN healthcare_provider_primary_taxonomy_switch_15 = 'Y' THEN healthcare_provider_taxonomy_15_specialization
              ELSE NULL END as primary_specialization
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized`
    WHERE LOWER(provider_business_practice_location_address_city_name) = 'mountain view'
      AND provider_business_practice_location_address_state_name = 'CA'
  )
  WHERE primary_specialization IS NOT NULL AND primary_specialization != ''
  GROUP BY primary_specialization
  ORDER BY distinct_npi_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_npi_count) as avg_cnt FROM top10
)
SELECT t.primary_specialization, t.distinct_npi_count
FROM top10 t, avg_count a
ORDER BY ABS(t.distinct_npi_count - a.avg_cnt) ASC
LIMIT 1
